title: Fraction Numerator‑Denominator Relationship
subject: Mathematics
topic: Sum of numerator and denominator equals 10
caption: Number line illustrating numerator = 3, denominator = 7, sum = 10, with the difference highlighted.
altText: A horizontal number line from 0 to 10 is drawn on a white background. Tick marks label each integer. The point at 3 is marked, and the segment from 3 to 10 is shaded light blue, indicating the difference of 7. Above the line the fraction 3/7 is shown, with separate labels 'Numerator = 3' and 'Denominator = 7'. A label at the right end reads 'Sum = 10'.
